chapter: New Orleans bands and later photographs
title: Tom as the first to mute a horn, and Ted 'Steve' Brown
summary: Mrs. Brown says Tom was first to mute a horn, making a tin mute, and Teagarden offered a mouthpiece for it; Ted is called Steve.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Growl, plunger and derby: the trumpet mute tradition

blocks.x: Tom was the first one that muted a horn.

And he made it in his shop out of tin. And he said when he went to Chicago, they couldn't understand the weird tones. So Teagarden, I says, gave him, oh, a beautiful mouthpiece. If he'd give him that mute. Could Tom...
could make them just like that you know. Then after that all come to use.
Steve mentioned that to us too. So we know it's true because his brother Ted or
Steve whichever you prefer to call him. We call him Steve. You call him Steve.
